about: The introitus of the formulary “8th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We have received Your mercy, O God, in the midst of Your temple. As is Your name, O God, so too is Your praise, to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of justice. Great is the Lord, and exceedingly worthy of praise, in the city of our God, on His holy mountain. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. We have received Your mercy, O God, in the midst of Your temple. As is Your name, O God, so too is Your praise, to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of justice.
